metadata.title: GistGap: What You See Is What You Sign
metadata.bookend_exempt_reason: Course pitch film, not a channel episode: it opens on the problem (B01) instead of a composer cold open, has no verdict card and no Your Turn composer, and carries no channel handle or persona. It also has no BOUT outro, which bookend_check.py cannot exempt; that script is not called by art run or art final.
metadata.audience: a hiring manager or an engineer reviewing a product-management portfolio project

beats.narration_text: Imagine an AI agent about to spend your money. You tap Approve. But what, exactly, are you approving?

shot.visual_intent: A robot holding a shopping bag stands beside a phone; a cursor taps the Approve button; a question mark appears.
shot.motion_claim: A robot holding a shopping bag stands beside a phone; a cursor taps the Approve button; a question mark appears.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn picture per beat on a cream stage with minimal labels; the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Two things matter here. What you're shown: the plain-English text on the screen. And what you sign: the exact terms, called a mandate. They should match.

shot.visual_intent: A box labelled SHOWN appears, then a taped box labelled SIGNED; a question mark lands between them.
shot.motion_claim: A box labelled SHOWN appears, then a taped box labelled SIGNED; a question mark lands between them.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn picture per beat on a cream stage with minimal labels; the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Here's an invented example. The cover page says fifty dollars, but page twelve says five hundred a month. That's the gap between the gist and the signed terms.

shot.visual_intent: A contract stack: the cover page reads $50; page 12 slides out and reads $500 / month; a curve joins them.
shot.motion_claim: A contract stack: the cover page reads $50; page 12 slides out and reads $500 / month; a curve joins them.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn picture per beat on a cream stage with minimal labels; the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: GistGap will be a web demo that tests whether the text shown to someone approving an agent's payment matches the signed terms. It will be a public GitHub repository with a demo page, a test set, and a results table.

shot.visual_intent: A browser window: the mandate's fields on the left, the shown text on the right, and a check lands between each matching row.
shot.motion_claim: A browser window: the mandate's fields on the left, the shown text on the right, and a check lands between each matching row.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn picture per beat on a cream stage with minimal labels; the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: It's for whoever owns an agent-payment approval screen. Before launch, they will be able to test, with synthetic data, whether the text drops or changes a cap, an amount, an expiry, or a recurrence.

shot.visual_intent: A launch checklist: two rows get checks; the third box, 'approval text tested?', stays empty and a dot marks it.
shot.motion_claim: A launch checklist: two rows get checks; the third box, 'approval text tested?', stays empty and a dot marks it.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn picture per beat on a cream stage with minimal labels; the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: I looked at two existing things. Google's AP2: I read the announcement post and the main spec page. And a buildathon repo: I read its README only. AP2 defines how mandates are signed and checked, and the repo checks payments against its own mandates. In what I read, neither tests the text a person is shown. GistGap will.

shot.visual_intent: Two boxes, AP2 and buildathon repo, appear; arrows run from both to a taped GistGap box.
shot.motion_claim: Two boxes, AP2 and buildathon repo, appear; arrows run from both to a taped GistGap box.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn picture per beat on a cream stage with minimal labels; the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: The target role is product manager for AI agent products. The reader is a hiring manager or an engineer. In the first sixty seconds, they will click three constructed examples and read the results table.

shot.visual_intent: Three example cards; a cursor clicks; a check lands on 'clean' and crosses on 'hidden cap' and 'changed amount'.
shot.motion_claim: Three example cards; a cursor clicks; a check lands on 'clean' and crosses on 'hidden cap' and 'changed amount'.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn picture per beat on a cream stage with minimal labels; the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: It will show four skills from this course: prompt contracts, verification, evaluation, and source grounding. The evidence will be the test set, the results table, dated Claude outputs, and predictions I commit before each run. It will not show that this works on real payments.

shot.visual_intent: Four icons arrive one by one: prompt contracts (a page), verification (a check), evaluation (bars), source grounding (a linked page and field).
shot.motion_claim: Four icons arrive one by one: prompt contracts (a page), verification (a check), evaluation (bars), source grounding (a linked page and field).

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn picture per beat on a cream stage with minimal labels; the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: In scope: five fields. Amount, merchant, spending cap, expiry date, and one-time versus recurring.

shot.visual_intent: Five dark bases; a box drops onto each as its field is named: amount, merchant, cap, expiry, recurring.
shot.motion_claim: Five dark bases; a box drops onto each as its field is named: amount, merchant, cap, expiry, recurring.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn picture per beat on a cream stage with minimal labels; the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Out of scope: real signing, real payments, protocol compliance, and checking what the user originally asked for. First, I will run ten constructed mandates, three with planted errors. I will know it ran if it flags exactly those three. I'll commit my prediction first.

shot.visual_intent: Left: four out-of-scope items, each with a cross beside it. Right: ten dots; three turn terracotta; rings mark exactly those three.
shot.motion_claim: Left: four out-of-scope items, each with a cross beside it. Right: ten dots; three turn terracotta; rings mark exactly those three.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn picture per beat on a cream stage with minimal labels; the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: The biggest risk: AP2 requires the display to be non-agentic, so the problem may be smaller than I think. I haven't examined any implementation. If so, I'll narrow the project. A second risk: matching text is brittle, because the same amount can be written several ways.

shot.visual_intent: A large box shrinks inside the outline of its old size; 'smaller problem?' appears beside it.
shot.motion_claim: A large box shrinks inside the outline of its old size; 'smaller problem?' appears beside it.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn picture per beat on a cream stage with minimal labels; the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: This is a mix, mainly learning. Payments and agent-payment protocols are new to me. What I already have is the Assignment 1 film and the commit trail you can see here. I want to learn fintech and break into fintech product management.

2a1f40f docs(prasad-s): checkpoint 2 - evidence packet (temp 1.0 vs 0.5) and pipeline check
